meta_description: Match Decorations is a trusted painter and decorator in Nottingham. Interior and exterior work, competitive quotes, reliable service. Call today.
hero_subhead: From feature walls to full exterior repaints, we transform your space with precision and care. Free quotes within 24 hours.
services_heading: Interior & Exterior Decorating Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: Whether you're refreshing a single room or tackling a full property renovation, we handle every detail with professionalism and pride.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Bedrooms, lounges, kitchens, and bathrooms transformed with expert preparation and premium finishes. We protect your furniture and leave no mess behind.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof your home with high-quality exterior paint and render work. We work in all seasons and handle fascias, soffits, and wood cladding.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Bespoke wallpaper hanging, from contemporary patterns to traditional designs. Perfect installation every time, including wall preparation and pattern matching.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, coving, and fitted furniture painted to showroom standard. Smooth, hard-wearing finishes that last for years.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Offices, shops, and rental properties refreshed quickly and efficiently. We schedule work around your business hours and minimise disruption.

services.title: Preparation & Problem Solving
services.desc: Damp patches, cracked plaster, and stained ceilings sorted before painting begins. Quality preparation is the secret to a flawless finish.

about_pullquote: Good preparation and honest pricing—that's how we've built our reputation.
about_para_1: Match Decorations was established in Nottingham over 15 years ago with a simple aim: deliver first-class painting and decorating without the premium prices. We've grown steadily by listening to what homeowners and landlords really want—reliable tradespeople who show up on time, do the job right, and respect your home.
about_para_2: Our customers recommend us because we don't rush. We prepare surfaces properly, use quality paints and materials, and always tidy up thoroughly. Many of our clients have used us multiple times, or recommended us to family and friends. We're Nottingham-based, insured, and proud of every job we complete.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had Mark come round to paint the whole of our downstairs. Brilliant job, very tidy, worked efficiently and finished on time. The standard of work is excellent. Would definitely recommend and will use again.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: We were really pleased with the quality of work. They prepared the walls properly, which made such a difference to the finish. Fair price too. Our lounge looks completely transformed. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Needed our exterior painted before winter. Match Decorations got it done in two days, no fuss, no drama. Really professional outfit. Best bit was the attention to detail—they even painted the guttering. Will be calling them back.
reviews.author: Robert K.
